name: std::basic_syncbuf<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::~basic_syncbuf
intro: Calls emit() to transmit all pending output (and delayed flush, if any) to the wrapped stream. If an exception is thrown by this call, it is caught and ignored.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Normally called by the destructor of the owning std::basic_osyncstream.
